You are a forager. Each round one plant is in season. To eat it, prepare it with the right 2 steps in the right order, each one of the listed actions. After each try you learn how many steps were right and in place. Right preparation: +4 energy. Anything else: -1. A plant keeps its preparation all season.
Reply with only JSON: {"steps": ["<action>", "<action>"]}

You are a tracker. Sites 1 to 6 lie in a circle; after site 6 comes site 1. Each animal moves the same number of sites forward every round. Each round, name the site where the animal is now. Then you learn where it was. Right site: +4 energy. Wrong: -1.
Reply with only JSON: {"site": <number>}
